serialPortHelp: Device path of the Victron MK2-USB or MK3-USB interface, for example /dev/ttyUSB0, /dev/serial/by-id/... or COM3. The adapter opens the port at 2400 baud. On Linux the ioBroker user needs access to the port (usually the dialout group).
pollIntervalHelp: Seconds between two complete polls. A full poll can take longer than the interval; in that case the next poll starts immediately.
responseTimeoutHelp: Maximum time in milliseconds to wait for one MK2 frame. The protocol recommends 500 ms; a busy host or a slow USB adapter may need more.
